chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The sin that displeases you is better in the view of Allah than the virtue which makes you proud.

key_terms.تُعْجِبُكَ: That makes you proud or pleased with yourself

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between a sin that displeases you and a virtue that makes you proud?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) teaches that a good deed accompanied by pride is inferior to a sin that causes genuine humility and displeasure, emphasizing that the quality of one's spiritual state often depends more on the sincerity of self-reflection than the magnitude of the act itself. This principle underscores the danger of spiritual arrogance (kibr) in evaluating one's spiritual state, a key theme in Shia ethics where the internal condition (batin) is weighed heavily against external actions (zahir).
